what_this_is: Provisional, quantity-only: the future-host criterion applied to the late hosts at 2%, the side run 'Future hosts as a second comparison group' under Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19, and E2's units, fake dates and design. The design stands as of 2026-11-18 and the plan is not frozen. Load, sales, customers, regions, ownership and the usable flag only; no price, revenue or bill is read.
ruling_of_2026_11_19: Add eligible future hosts to each cohort's side-run comparison pool and match under the existing rules. Report how many enter the matches and any sample changes. This does not change the headline pool.

criterion.quiet_through: g+3, share under 0.5% in every year from 2001
criterion.agent_reading_no_crossing_in_the_panel: a history with no crossing through 2025 meets 'g+7 or later' only where g+7 is 2026 or earlier

histories.source: timing.StateRun's screen cases and pass_c_exact._State.grid over each unit's relevant questions, one representative per class of settings merged for the unit; both readings; plus the slow path of headline-set rule 2 (adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19, D-111)
histories.inputs_note: timing.load_rebuilt reads data/interim/epoch_gaps.parquet, which this pass may not read; it sets a value read only for fixed-history rows with a not_a_site correction, and none is in force. Every late host's place test reproduces the frozen one (place_test_reproduction).
outside_the_admissible_histories_by_the_: the ten-year screen case (a labelled stress test, D-54 ruling 1)
the permit-error reach (reported under its own name, D-61 section 6)
stress scenarios (never an admissible history, D-96 item 3)
the later-start shifts (chosen stress sizes, reported beside the result)
the state's unassigned remainder (a stated limit, not a history, D-46 ruling 6)
rows with no size (they carry no load in any history)
